value.name: Sonoma Clean Power
value.notes: Sonoma Clean Power is the public power provider for Sonoma and Mendocino counties, serving all incorporated cities in Sonoma County except Healdsburg (its own municipal utility) and Ukiah (Mendocino County). PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Rohnert Park/Sonoma County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

required_documents.notes: The page confirms applicants apply through the Symbium automated permitting platform but does not itself enumerate a specific document checklist.

value: Schedule building inspections via the online portal at rpccrw.rpcity.org/etrakit3/ (Google Chrome recommended)
Inspections are offered Monday through Friday, 8:30 am to noon and 1 to 3 pm; an AM or PM time slot must be requested when scheduling
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building Division inspection scheduling process (the same FAQ covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

other_conditions: Automated permits available only for rooftop systems on single-family homes and duplexes, including those with energy storage systems
Other solar project types must submit for an Electrical permit through the City's eTRAKiT system
